channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Kelly: bring back the maor foirne
item.description: Offaly hurling boss Johnny Kelly has reiterated his call for the return of the maor foirne.

item.title: Conlon glad to be back after freak injury almost ended his career
item.description: John Conlon was delighted to make his Clare return against Down last Sunday, just seven months after almost losing a finger in a freak accident.

item.title: Former LGFA President Walter Thompson passes away
item.description: Ladies Gaelic Football Association President Trina Murray has led tributes to former LGFA President Walter Thompson, who passed away last Saturday.

item.title: Spectators injured as fence collapses after Corn Uí Dhuill final
item.description: Three spectators were treated for injuries after a fence gave way during the celebrations which followed St Kieran's College's Leinster Post Primary Schools Senior Hurling 'A' Championship final victory over city rivals Kilkenny CBC at UPMC Nowlan Park last weekend.

item.title: Sheedy hits out at Páirc boo boys
item.description: Liam Sheedy has labelled the booing of Darragh McCarthy during Tipperary's Allianz Hurling League Division 1A defeat to Cork as 'unacceptable'.

item.title: Ballygunner to field two senior teams as Waterford club draws are made
item.description: The 2026 Waterford senior and intermediate club championship draws were made on Monday night and were notable for the inclusion of two Ballygunner teams in the SHC.

item.title: Walsh reappointed Kilkenny football manager
item.description: Christy Walsh has been ratified as Kilkenny junior football manager for a second year.

item.title: O'Shea poised to take Ballymun reins
item.description: Former Mayo star Seamus O'Shea is set to be named as the new Ballymun Kickhams senior football manager.

item.title: Sigerson Cup final takes centre stage
item.description: UCC and UL face off in a fascinating Sigerson Cup final at Croke Park this evening.

item.title: Kerry club football championship draws take place
item.description: The draws have been made for the 2026 Kerry club football championships.
